source: Dallas City Code ch. 51P, Article 387 (City Attorney's codified article, April 2026)

sections.title: Legislative History
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-387.101. LEGISLATIVE HISTORY.

PD 387 was established by Ordinance No. 21795, passed by the Dallas City Council on September 8, 1993. Ordinance No. 21795 amended Ordinance No. 19455, Chapter 51A of the Dallas City Code, as amended. (Ord. Nos. 19455; 21795; 25850)

sections.title: Property Location And Size
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-387.102. PROPERTY LOCATION AND SIZE.

PD 387 is established on property located approximately 770 feet north of the north line of Hackberry Road, and 331 feet east of the east line of Belt Line Road. The size of PD 387 is approximately 0.6 acres. (Ord. Nos. 21795; 25850; 26233)

sections.title: Definitions And Interpretations
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-387.103. DEFINITIONS AND INTERPRETATIONS.

(a) Definitions. Unless otherwise stated, the definitions contained in Chapter 51A apply to this article.

(b) Interpretations.

(1) Unless otherwise stated, all references to code articles, divisions, or sections in this article refer to articles, divisions, or sections in Chapter 51A.

(2) Section 51A-2.101, “Interpretations,” applies to this article.

(3) The following rules apply in interpreting the use regulations in this article:

(A) The absence of a symbol appearing after a listed use means that the use is permitted by right.

(B) The symbol [L] appearing after a listed use means that the use is permitted by right as a limited use only.

(C) The symbol [DIR] appearing after a listed use means that a site plan must be submitted and approved in accordance with the requirements of Section 51A-4.803. (“DIR” means “development impact review.” For more information regarding development impact review generally, see Division 51A-4.800.)

(4) For purposes of determining the applicability of regulations in this article and in Chapter 51A triggered by adjacency or proximity to another zoning district, and for purposes of interpreting the DIR and RAR requirements of Division 51A-4.800, this district is considered to be a nonresidential zoning district.

(c) Note: Tract B, Tract C, and most of Tract A were re-zoned to Planned Development District No. 741 by Ordinance No. 26233, on January 25, 2006, but no amendments were made to the conceptual plan or conditions for this district. (Ord. Nos. 21795; 25850; 26233)

sections.title: Conceptual Plan
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-387.104. CONCEPTUAL PLAN.

Development and use of the Property must comply with the conceptual plan (Exhibit 387A). (Ord. Nos. 21795; 25850)

sections.title: Development Plan
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-387.105. DEVELOPMENT PLAN.

A development plan must be submitted to and approved by the commission before a building permit may be issued. The development plan need not be submitted within six months of September 8, 1993. (Ord. Nos. 21795; 25850)

sections.title: Main Uses Permitted
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-387.106. MAIN USES PERMITTED.

(a) Agricultural uses.

-- Commercial stable. -- Crop production.

(b) Commercial and business service uses.

-- Medical or scientific laboratory.

(c) Industrial uses.

-- Industrial (inside) not potentially incompatible. [DIR]

(d) Institutional and community service uses.

-- Child-care facility. -- Library, art gallery, or museum. [Tract B only.]

(e) Lodging uses.

-- Hotel or motel. [L]

(f) Office uses.

-- Office. [Tract B only.]

(g) Recreation uses.

-- Private recreation center, club, or area. -- Public park, playground, or golf course.

(h) Retail and personal service uses.

-- Motor vehicle fueling station. -- Restaurant without drive-in or drive-through service. [L] [Tract B only.]

(i) Transportation uses.

-- Helistop. -- Private street or alley.

(j) Utility and public service uses.

-- Commercial radio or television transmitting station. -- Electrical generating plant. -- Electrical substation. -- Local utilities. -- Radio, television, or microwave tower. -- Tower/antenna for cellular communication. -- Utility or government installation other than listed. (Ord. Nos. 21795; 25850)

sections.title: Accessory Uses
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-387.107. ACCESSORY USES.

As a general rule, an accessory use is permitted in any district in which the main use is permitted. Some specific types of accessory uses, however, due to their unique nature, are subject to additional regulations contained in Section 51A-4.217. For more information regarding accessory uses, consult Section 51A-4.217. (Ord. Nos. 21795; 25850)

sections.title: Yard, Lot, And Space Regulations
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-387.108. YARD, LOT, AND SPACE REGULATIONS.

(Note: The yard, lot, and space regulations in this section must be read together with the yard, lot, and space regulations contained in Division 51A-4.400. In the event of a conflict between this section and Division 51A-4.400, this section controls.)

(a) Front, side, and rear yards. Except as shown on the conceptual plan, minimum front, side, and rear yards are 10 feet. Parking spaces and signs are allowed in the setback from Hackberry Road.

(b) Dwelling unit density. No dwelling units permitted.

(c) Floor area ratio. Maximum floor area ratio is 0.25 for all uses combined.

(d) Height.

(1) Enclosed buildings. Maximum height for an enclosed building is 48 feet.

(2) Other structures.

(A) Tract A. Maximum height for any other structure on Tract A is 225 feet.

(B) Tracts B and C. Maximum height for any other structure on Tracts B and C is 125 feet.

(e) Lot coverage. Maximum lot coverage is 25 percent. Aboveground parking structures are included in lot coverage calculations; surface parking lots and underground parking structures are not.

(f) Lot size. No minimum lot size.

(g) Stories. Maximum number of stories above grade is five. (Ord. Nos. 21795; 25850)

sections.title: Off-Street Parking And Loading
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-387.109. OFF-STREET PARKING AND LOADING.

(a) Parking. For all uses combined in this district, 50 spaces or one per 2,000 square feet of floor area must be provided, whichever is greater. Handicapped parking must be provided in accordance with Section 51A-4.305. All parking must be installed in accordance with Chapter 51A.

(b) Loading. Required loading must be provided in accordance with Chapter 51A. (Ord. Nos. 21795; 25850)

sections.title: Environmental Performance Standards
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-387.110. ENVIRONMENTAL PERFORMANCE STANDARDS.

See Article VI. (Ord. Nos. 21795; 25850)

sections.title: Landscaping
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-387.111. LANDSCAPING.

A landscape plan for Tract B must be submitted in conjunction with the submission of a development plan for Tract B. Landscaping is only required in areas adjacent to buildings or parking lots on Tract B. Although the landscape plan need not earn a minimum number of points pursuant to Section 51A-10.105, that plan must be approved by the commission before a building permit may be issued. All landscaping must be provided as shown on the landscape plan and be installed in accordance with Article
X. All plant material must be maintained in a healthy, growing condition at all times. (Ord. Nos. 21795; 25850)

sections.title: Signs
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-387.112. SIGNS.

Signs must comply with the provisions for business zoning districts contained in Article VII. (Ord. Nos. 21795; 25850)

sections.title: Additional Provisions
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-387.113. ADDITIONAL PROVISIONS.

Development and use of the Property must comply with all applicable federal and state laws and regulations, and with all applicable ordinances, rules, and regulations of the city. (Ord. Nos. 21795; 25850)

sections.title: Paving
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-387.114. PAVING.

All paved areas, permanent drives, streets, and drainage structures, if any, must be constructed in accordance with standard city specifications, and completed to the satisfaction of the director of public works and transportation. (Ord. Nos. 21795; 25850)

sections.title: Compliance With Conditions
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-387.115. COMPLIANCE WITH CONDITIONS.

The building official shall not issue a building permit or a certificate of occupancy for a use in this PD until there has been full compliance with this article, the Dallas Development Code, the construction codes, and all other applicable ordinances, rules, and regulations of the city. (Ord. Nos. 21795; 25850)

sections.title: Zoning Map
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-387.116. ZONING MAP.

PD 387 is located on Zoning Map Nos. C-2 and D-2. (Ord. Nos. 21795; 25850)
